newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wee Poh Holdings wins S$46 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Wee Poh Holdings wins S$46 mln contract.

text.p: Wee Poh Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its subsidiary Wee Poh Construction Co Pte Ltd won a government contract worth Singapore $46 million.
It said in a statement it had been successful in a tender issued by the Land Transport Authority for construction work to widen the Pan Island Expressway.
The work is expected to start this month and is scheduled for completion at the end of 1999.
The contract is not expected to have any material impact on the company's earnings for the current financial year, it said.
